title: Chiyo (Fish It)
features:
Auto Fish – Blatant and Legit modes for instant perfect catches.
Auto Farm – Automatically farms Coins or Enchant Stones to a set threshold.
Auto Sell – Sells your inventory automatically at configurable intervals.
Auto Equip – Keeps your best rod and bobber equipped, with a customizable blacklist.
Auto Buy – Purchases the best affordable rods, bobbers, and specified weather events.
Auto Open Crates – Continuously opens a selected crate type.
Auto Enchant – Uses Enchant Stones on a selected rod until a desired enchant is rolled.
Auto Favorite – Favorites fish by rarity, weight, shiny, big, or specific mutation status.
Auto Mastery & Quests – Automatically completes fishing mastery and main questlines, including the Ghostfinn Rod quest.
Teleports – Instantly travel to any island, NPC, player, or a saved custom location.
Server Hop – Rejoin or switch servers based on player count (high or low).
Discord Webhooks – Get notifications for rare catches and detailed player stat updates.
Player Mods – Anti-AFK, Anti-Drown, Infinite Jump, and customizable Speed/Jump.
Misc – Fish Radar, Auto Diving Gear, Auto Event Farm, FPS Boost.
